images_source_valid.name: images_source_valid
images_source_valid.value: ("product_images"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "product_images"."demo_source_url" IS NULL AND length(trim("product_images"."storage_key")) > 0) OR ("product_images"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "product_images"."demo_source_url" IS NOT NULL)

variants_stock_valid.name: variants_stock_valid
variants_stock_valid.value: ("product_variants"."track_inventory" AND "product_variants"."stock_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."stock_quantity" >= 0) OR (NOT "product_variants"."track_inventory" AND "product_variants"."stock_quantity" IS NULL)

orders_contact_valid.name: orders_contact_valid
orders_contact_valid.value: length(trim("orders"."customer_name")) > 0 AND length(trim("orders"."address")) > 0 AND length(trim("orders"."area")) > 0 AND "orders"."phone" ~ '^\+8801[3-9][0-9]{8}$'
